facts.fact: The article states that Benin has a law protecting personal data, loi n° 2017-20 (Code du numérique) as amended by loi n° 2020-35 of 6 January 2021, and describes it in the present tense; it gives no date for this state, so the published date 2025-05-05 is used.
facts.system: Code du numérique (loi n° 2017-20, as amended by loi n° 2020-35)

facts.fact: The article says the law created the APDP as an independent administrative authority and sets its composition (3 deputies, 2 qualified persons, 1 presidential appointee, 1 magistrate, 1 lawyer); it names no appointments, so the published date 2025-05-05 is used.
facts.system: Code du numérique (loi n° 2017-20, as amended by loi n° 2020-35)
